An '''ion attractor''' was a piece of equipment that functioned much like a [[lightning rod]]. It would draw in the energy of [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]], resulting in danger to those near it in a storm. The energy gathered by the attractor was potent enough to [[Death/Legends|kill]] even a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] in a single strike.
